name: Ginnungagap
source:
A story that follows a protagonist who was hired as a "God." Watch as she goes from first getting a job to when she goes insane.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28145]Freem![/url]]
translation:
讲述被聘为“神”的主人公的故事。看着她从第一次找到工作到发疯的整个过程。

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28145]Freem![/url]]
